title: Fernwood - where does the door go?  (414 x A+, her measured conditions)
decision: Does the login sit before the app, inside it, or once at the threshold?
criteria: Crossed once not per visit | never gates the glance | label promises the destination not the mechanism | recovery is a person
recommend: R1-B: the only option that never puts anything between her and the weather card, which is both of her card opens since lap 4.

exhibits.label: no door (today)
exhibits.note: The journey has ZERO steps today: opening the app IS arriving at Fernwood.
exhibits.look: There is no way in, because there is nothing yet to keep out.

exhibits.label: the lobby
exhibits.note: A full-screen sign-in BEFORE the app. What 'logging in' usually means.
exhibits.look: She meets a door before she meets the place. The glance is behind it.

exhibits.label: the room
exhibits.note: No entry screen. The door appears in the card stream, where the private content would be.
exhibits.look: Weather and the jump strip are untouched above it — she meets this only by reaching for receipts.

exhibits.label: the threshold
exhibits.note: A one-time card on first open, above the jump strip; never seen again on this phone.
exhibits.look: It sits between her and the glance ONCE. Compare that cost against B's zero.
